revenue.source: Costco 10-Ks via financial_statements: FY2024 acc 0000909832-25-000101, FY2025 acc 0000909832-25-000101, FY2026 acc 0000909832-26-000093 (Revenues / RevenueFromContractWithCustomer)

revenue_growth.source: Assumption: fades from FY2026 growth of 10.1% (303,154/275,235) and FY2025 8.2% toward a mature rate as the warehouse base scales; analyst judgment, not company guidance.

ebit_margin.source: Assumption: FY2026 EBIT margin 3.85% (11,685/303,154), up from 3.66% FY2024 and 3.77% FY2025; hold roughly flat with slight gains from membership fee income.

tax_rate.source: Assumption: FY2026 effective rate about 24.7% (1 - NI 9,226 / pretax 12,251, acc 0000909832-26-000093); rounded to 25%.

capex_pct_revenue.source: Assumption: FY2026 capex/revenue 2.12% (6,435/303,154); expansion continues, held at about 2.1%.

wacc.source: CAPM: Rf 4.86% (US Treasury 10Y, 2026-11-06) + relevered beta 0.855 x ERP 4.46% (Damodaran US, 2026-02-16) = 8.67% cost of equity. Beta is Damodaran Retail (Grocery and Food) cash-corrected unlevered 0.848 relevered at Costco D/E of about 0.01 (debt 6.2B vs large market cap; my estimate). Debt weight is negligible, so WACC is about 8.6%.

terminal_growth.source: Assumption: below the 4.86% risk-free rate and in line with long-run nominal US GDP growth; a conservative rate for a still-expanding retailer.

net_debt.source: financial_statements derived net_debt = total debt 6,162 (LTD noncurrent 3,914 + current 2,248) - cash 20,207 - short-term investments 1,094; acc 0000909832-26-000093. Negative means net cash.
